# Rubber Band

Vendored from the pinned npm package `rubberband-wasm@3.3.0`.
The package builds Rubber Band Library 3.3.0 with the R3 engine.

- Bindings and build recipe — https://github.com/Daninet/rubberband-wasm
- Library source — https://breakfastquay.com/files/releases/rubberband-3.3.0.tar.bz2
- Library licensing — https://breakfastquay.com/rubberband/

The included library and bindings are GPLv2. `LICENSE.txt` contains the package's
licence. `UPSTREAM-build.sh` records the upstream build recipe. Proprietary
distribution requires an appropriate commercial licence from the library vendor.
